This editorial illustration features a portrait-style digital painting of a light-skinned person’s face against a solid black background. The person has dark hair and dark eyes looking directly forward. A large, black, gloved hand is positioned in the foreground, partially obscuring the person's face from the nose downward. The hand's fingers are splayed, with the index and middle fingers extending upwards toward the person's right eye.

At the top, the large red serif text "TEMPO" is centered. Above it, in smaller white sans-serif letters, is "EDISI KHUSUS". Below the "O" in "TEMPO" is the date "8-14 DESEMBER 2014". Near the bottom, white sans-serif text reads "FAKTA BARU" and "PEMBUNUHAN MUNIR". Below this, smaller white text says: "Video rahasia intel senior memperkuat dugaan keterlibatan Badan Intelijen Negara dalam kematian Munir. Tempo menelusuri hingga Lisabon, Portugal." 

In the bottom right corner, a small box contains "RP 35.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", "ISSN: 0126-4273", a barcode, and the number "00041".
